svg.title: dina
svg.desc: Hexagonal logo for the R package dina, read left to right like a signal path. Three dead-straight input wires, each carrying a solid bit cell with the digit 1, enter from the left edge over a faint dot grid and meet the flat back of a large solid AND gate with the word dina cut out of it. The single output wire leaves the middle of the gate's curved front and becomes a Bayesian point-interval: a thick bar with a dot at the median. Above it an orange posterior density rises out of the gate, labelled one minus s, and a dashed flat line crosses it low down: the uniform prior it was updated from.
